units: <cite ref="Sotah 10b:12">Sot. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>כל עובר ושָׁב</he> every passer-by (in going or coming back).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48:16">Gen. R. s. 48</cite>, a. fr. <he>העוברים והשָׁבִים</he> the travellers.
Lev. R. s. 23 ושָׁבַת נפשו עליו (not עליה) and his soul came back (was restored) to him, i.e. he was reconciled; a. fr.—Esp. to return (to God); to repent.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 110a:6">B. Bath. 110ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>ש̇ב̇א̇ל̇</he> <cite ref="I Chronicles 26:24">I Chr. XXVI, 24</cite>) <he>שש̇ב̇ לא̇ל̇ בכל לבו</he> he returned to God with all his heart.

<cite ref="Horayot 2a:16">Hor. 2ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 4:22">Lev. IV, 22</cite>, sq.) <he>השב … לא שב וכ׳</he> he who repents when he finds out (his wrong) brings a sacrifice for his error; if he does not repent, he is not permitted to sacrifice.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:10">Ab. II, 10</cite> <he>ושׁוּב יום וכ׳</he> repent one day before thy death.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:6">Ex. R. s. 42</cite> <he>לעולם מקבלים השבים</he> repentant sinners are accepted at all times; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to bring back, return, restore. Y. Yoma VIII, 45ᵃ bot. החומץ מֵשִׁיב את הנפש vinegar restores life, is a refreshing drink.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 51b">Gitt. 51ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אינו אלא כמשיב … ופטור</he> he is in that case like one who restores a lost object, and therefore is not bound to make oath.
<cite ref="Gittin 51b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>לית ליה משיב … פטור</he> he is not of the opinion that he who restores a lost object is exempt from making oath; a. fr.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:14">Ab. II, 14</cite> <he>ורע מה שתָּשִׁיב וכ׳</he> that you may know how to answer the sceptic. Y. Gitt. IX, beg. 50ᵃ <he>נכנסו … להָשִׁיב על דבריו וכ׳</he> four elders met to refute R. Eliezer’s words; Bab.

<cite ref="Gittin 83a">Gitt. 83ᵃ</cite>; Tosef. ib. IX (VII), 1. Y. l. c. <he>אין אתם מְשִׁיבִים את הארי וכ׳</he> are you not going to refute the lion after he is dead?; Bab. ib. l. c. <he>אין מְשִׁיבִין וכ׳</he> you dare not refute &c. Y. l. c. <he>ה׳ ר׳ טרפון</he> R. T. argued &c. (Bab. l. c. <he>נענה</he>; Tosef. l. c. <cite ref="A02060"><he>אמר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 63b">B. Kam. 63ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין משיבין על הקישא</he> you must not argue against a conclusion from analogy.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:4">Ab. Zar. III, 4</cite> <he>אין משיבין במרחץ</he> we must not answer (a religious question) in the bath-house.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 21b:4">M. Kat. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>מֵשִׁיב ואינו שואל</he> the mourner may answer (a salutation), but must not salute; <he>שואל ומשיב כדרכו</he> he may salute and answer as usual; a. fr.—[Y. Gitt. VIII, 49ᶜ top, in Chald. dict. <he>משיב</he>, v. <cite ref="V00142"><he>תּוּב</he> I</cite>.]
<cite ref="Megillah 15a">Meg. 15ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10b:6">Ab. Zar. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>אין משיבין על הקלקלה</he> you need not go back (to him that sent you) to bring bad news.

senses.gloss: to be replied; to refer. Y. B. Kam. II, 3ᵃ top על הראשונה הוּשָׁבָה the modification in the Mishnah (במה דברים אמורים) refers to the first clause only; על כולה הושבה it refers to the whole paragraph. Y. Bicc. II, 65ᵃ top; a. e.
